input.command:
<skill-venv>/bin/python - <<'EOF'
import json, os
data = {
  "schema_version": "1.1",
  "spread": "three",
  "question": None,
  "question_provided": False,
  "question_echoed": False,
  "deck": "Rider-Waite-Smith; Strength VIII; Justice XI",
  "algorithm": "uniform-without-replacement",
  "randomness": "system-random",
  "seed": None,
  "reversed_probability": 0.5,
  "cards": [
    {"position": "过去", "card": "月亮", "orientation": "逆位", "is_major": True},
    {"position": "现在", "card": "权杖九", "orientation": "逆位", "is_major": False},
    {"position": "可能走向", "card": "圣杯七", "orientation": "逆位", "is_major": False}
  ]
}
path = "<host-scratch>/tarot-draw-three.json"
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump(data, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
print("written:", path)
EOF
